abstract.para: This document lists configuration keys referenced by the classes roart.common.config.NodeConfig, MyConfig and the constants in ConfigConstants. The values shown are the literal configuration keys (e.g. "mp.cpu") and an inferred type and short description.
Assumptions: where no explicit default constant exists, "Default" is listed as "none". Keys marked "[@enable]" are treated as booleans.

chapter.title: Overview
chapter.para: The configuration system returns values via NodeConfig accessors/wrappers which consult a runtime map of configuration values and a defaults map (see MyConfig.deflt). The following chapters group keys by functional area.

section.title: mp.cpu
section.para: Key: "mp.cpu" - Type: number (double inferred) - Used by: NodeConfig.getMPCpu() - Description: CPU quota or weight for multi-process work (e.g. conversion/indexing). Default: none

section.title: mp.batch
section.para: Key: "mp.batch" - Type: integer - Used by: NodeConfig.getMPBatch() - Description: Batch size for multi-process tasks. Default: none

section.title: mp.threads.fs
section.para: Key: "mp.threads.fs" - Type: integer - Used by: NodeConfig.getMPThreadsFS() - Description: Number of threads for filesystem-related parallel work. Default: none

section.title: mp.threads.convert
section.para: Key: "mp.threads.convert" - Type: integer - Used by: NodeConfig.getMPThreadsConvert() - Description: Number of threads for conversion tasks. Default: none

section.title: mp.threads.index
section.para: Key: "mp.threads.index" - Type: integer - Used by: NodeConfig.getMPThreadsIndex() - Description: Number of threads for indexing tasks. Default: none

section.title: mp.queue.limit
section.para: Key: "mp.queue.limit" - Type: integer - Used by: NodeConfig.getMPQueueLimit() - Description: Queue capacity limit for multi-process task queues. Default: none

chapter.title: Notes & Next Steps
chapter.para: - The descriptions above are intentionally concise. For richer docs include example values and usage sections per key. - If you want this file integrated into a build or transformed into HTML/PDF, I can add a small DocBook XSLT toolchain and a README describing how to render it.
